keyservers.description: List of keyserver hosts (HKP/HTTPS) to use for key lookup. Each item must specify 'host'; 'port' is optional and defaults to 80 for HTTP or 443 for HKPS.

port.description: Port to use (e.g., 80 for HKP, 443 for HKPS). If omitted, defaults are inferred from scheme (http: 80, https: 443).

gpg_agent_socket.description: Explicit path to gpg-agent's S. socket (e.g., '/run/user/1000/gnupg/S.gpg-agent'). Usually auto-detected; leave empty to omit.
